Class Ledger

java.lang.Object
network.ike.tooling.buildreport.Ledger
public final class Ledger extends Object
The committed acceptance ledger, normally read from .mvn/build-report.yaml at the execution root.

Expected shape:

mode: report          # report | gate
accepted:
  - key: model-problem/bom-import-from-reactor
    count: 2
    reason: accepted by design — see IKE-WORKSPACE.md
    since: 2026-08-10

A missing file yields empty(): report mode, no accepted entries — every warning finding surfaces under ATTENTION.

    • evaluate

      public LedgerEvaluation evaluate(List<Finding> findings)
      Compares a session's findings against this ledger.

      Severity.ERROR findings go to failures unconditionally. Warning findings are grouped by key: unaccepted keys and counts above expectation go to attention; counts at expectation go to accepted; counts below expectation (including zero) go to both accepted bookkeeping and the ratchet list.

      Parameters:
      findings - the session's findings in observation order
      Returns:
      the evaluation backing the receipt's sections

    • gatingAttention

      public List<LedgerEvaluation.AttentionItem> gatingAttention(LedgerEvaluation evaluation)
      Filters an evaluation's attention items down to those that gate.

      An attention item gates unless its key has a ledger entry whose per-entry mode is LedgerMode.REPORT — the onboarding override. Unaccepted keys have no entry and therefore always gate.

      Parameters:
      evaluation - the evaluation to filter
      Returns:
      the gating attention items, in evaluation order
